[[File:Great_glyph_of_strength.png|thumb|The glyph.]]
The '''Great Glyph of Strength''' was an ancient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] symbol. According to legend, it had [[Magic/Legends|magical]] properties to it, which made Ewoks nearby more resistant and hardy, even more than with the [[Glyph of Strength]].

The glyph depicted two drops of liquid. [[Ewok glyphs]] would often be carved on trees where Ewoks lived.
